Debug Adapter Protocol specification, Microsoft Corporation.
Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/debug-adapter-protocol/a62c4164506dad981bbccd4d278c584255f1b5b8/debugAdapterProtocol.json (v1.34.0).
debugserver-types generates Rust protocol types from this specification.
The source schema is unchanged except for CRLF/LF line endings.

deno_core_icudata: wrapper MIT declaration and embedded ICU data have separate notices.
The published 10,822,192-byte src/icudtl.dat is byte-identical to Chromium ICU ee5f27adc28bd3f15b2c293f726d14d2e336cbd5/common/icudtl.dat.
The complete 26,487-byte same-revision ICU LICENSE bundle follows, including Unicode-3.0 and its third-party notices. This preserves the upstream bundle; it does not assert that every listed source/build tool is shipped in the data blob.
ICU source: https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/deps/icu/+/ee5f27adc28bd3f15b2c293f726d14d2e336cbd5/common/icudtl.dat?format=TEXT
